plans.title: Tipuana level 1

source.what: Room sign-up plan of Tipuana level 1 ("FLOOR PLAN - BUILDING 2 - LEVEL 01": CAD plan with unit numbers, bedrooms A to D, stairs and elevators)

plans.how: The plan's footprint is fitted to the building outline by ICP (the plan carries no scale bar, so the outline fit is the only scale). No north arrow on the plan. The Regents' January 2018 design plan for the Southwest Campus Apartments draws the same three buildings in the same orientation with a north arrow pointing to the page's upper left (the page's up is north-east), so the ICP starts from that rotation.

fit.transform: similarity, plan footprint fitted to the building outline (ICP)

notes: Unit numbers are printed as -NN on the sheet (the level is the sheet's, so -13 on the level 2 sheet is unit 13 of level 2); they are kept as labels in that printed form, not as room numbers. Bedroom letters A to D are read by OCR; a letter alone is not a room number.
No scale bar on the plan: the scale comes from the outline fit.
